test.fill_query: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('test_parquet_string_sizes.parquet', Parquet) SELECT toUInt32(number % 1000) AS counter, if(number % 10 = 0, '', concat('https://example.com/', repeat('path/', number % 8), toString(intHash64(number)), '.html')) AS url, if(number % 7 = 0, concat('phrase ', toString(number % 1000)), '') AS phrase FROM numbers(10000000) SETTINGS output_format_parquet_row_group_size = 1000000, engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1, max_block_size = 1000000, max_insert_block_size = 1000000
test.query: SELECT counter, avg(length(url)) AS l, count() AS c FROM file('test_parquet_string_sizes.parquet', Parquet) WHERE url != '' GROUP BY counter ORDER BY l DESC LIMIT 25 SETTINGS max_threads = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT counter, count() AS c FROM file('test_parquet_string_sizes.parquet', Parquet) WHERE phrase != '' GROUP BY counter ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10 SETTINGS max_threads = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM file('test_parquet_string_sizes.parquet', Parquet) WHERE notEmpty(phrase) SETTINGS max_threads = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM file('test_parquet_string_sizes.parquet', Parquet) WHERE empty(url) SETTINGS max_threads = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(length(url)) FROM file('test_parquet_string_sizes.parquet', Parquet) SETTINGS max_threads = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM file('test_parquet_string_sizes.parquet', Parquet) WHERE url LIKE '%abc%' SETTINGS max_threads = 1 FORMAT Null
